name: cation_leak_read
purpose: TASKS 257: does a trained cation's correction leak onto its neutral skeleton? Per family first-order error, data arm v14s3full (with P3c) against the probe v14s3nop3c (without), on the 43 pool parents whose cation trained, 987 control pool molecules, and hold-out (a)'s benzene and 2-naphthoic acid (also against the clean arm). Read-only.

estimate.basis: product_error_read took 102 s for 47 molecules x 3 checkpoints on 16 Nov 2026 (about 0.7 s per molecule and checkpoint); this read is 1,030 molecules x 4 checkpoints plus 2 x 7

memory.basis: product_error_read_v14clean, the same molecule_read with three checkpoints per molecule, one molecule at a time (declared 3.0 GB on a measured 1.94 GB max RSS of a larger evaluation; a 0.5 GB read of this kind passed the door on 18 Nov); this read holds at most three checkpoints at a time and prints its own peak
